mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome! If you've ever wondered what really sets successful founders apart—or felt the thrill and uncertainty of bringing a new idea to life—you're in the right place. Together, let's explore what happens when ambition meets innovation in the unpredictable world of entrepreneurship. You know, the journey from spark to thriving company isn’t just about strategy—it’s deeply shaped by how we think and what we believe is possible. In her thoughtful book, New Startup Mindset: Ten Mindset Shifts to Build the Company of Your Dreams, Sandra Shpilberg opens up a new perspective, showing us how small changes in mindset can create big opportunities. We’ll walk through ten powerful shifts together—each one inviting us to let go of old assumptions and try a more authentic, sustainable way to build and lead. Along the way, you’ll hear practical insights and real-world stories that bring these ideas to life, helping us see how resilience, experimentation, and purpose can turn obstacles into stepping stones. So, as we set out on this journey, get ready to challenge what you think you know about entrepreneurship. This isn’t just about surviving the startup world—it’s about discovering what truly matters to you, and building something meaningful, lasting, and uniquely yours. Let’s dive in and see where this adventure takes us.
